caption: The preview shows three entries and one missing photo.
eval: (async()=>{{app.plugins.plugins['diaro-backup-import'].closeImportWindows(); const p=app.plugins.plugins['diaro-backup-import']; const f=app.vault.getFileByPath('Diaro Backup Import/Demo backup.zip'); const b=p.readBackup(new Uint8Array(await app.vault.readBinary(f))); p.settings.folder='Diaro demo'; p.settings.mapping={noteName:'date-title',titleProperty:'title',folderProperty:'diaro_folder',moodProperty:'diaro_mood',tagsProperty:'tags'};let token='gho_'+'0'.repeat(36); p.pro.opts.tokens.get=()=>token; p.pro.opts.tokens.set=(v)=>{token=v;}; p.pro.opts.tokens.clear=()=>{token=null;}; p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader',totalSponsorshipAmountAsSponsorInCents:1500},user:{viewerIsSponsoring:true,sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); await p.pro.refreshNow();await p.importPlan(await p.prepare(b,'Diaro demo',p.settings.mapping),true); p.pro.signOut();}app.plugins.plugins['diaro-backup-import'].closeImportWindows(); const p=app.plugins.plugins['diaro-backup-import']; const f=app.vault.getFileByPath('Diaro Backup Import/Demo backup.zip'); const b=p.readBackup(new Uint8Array(await app.vault.readBinary(f))); p.settings.folder='Diaro demo'; p.settings.mapping={noteName:'date-title',titleProperty:'title',folderProperty:'diaro_folder',moodProperty:'diaro_mood',tagsProperty:'tags'};p.pro.signOut(); const m=p.openImport(b); await m.refreshPreview(); m.contentEl.scrollTop=0; return '3 entries, 1 photo, 1 missing photo';})()
